item.title: Allow EVPN cross-zone routing on exit nodes
item.author: invalid@example.com (wth)
item.dc:creator: wth
item.content:encoded:
Current implementation of EVPN stack explicitly generates blackhole (null0) routes for each VRFs' each subnet that prevents zones to communicate with each other on exit nodes.

This behavior is undesired in setups where all nodes are also exit nodes: this happens when the nodes have dedicated links for external VM traffic to upstream router and the node itself needs to handle all the routing between the subnets (be it normal or EVPN managed) on other also dedicated high-bandwidth links...
